data.name: Shadow Division: Spymaster
data.detailed_description:
Early 2022. The fictional nation of Novibor faces invasion by its larger neighbor, Volgravia. Your military is outnumbered and outgunned, and conventional victory may be impossible.

You are the newly appointed director of the Shadow Division, Novibor's intelligence service.

Recruit and manage agents. Build intelligence networks abroad. Infiltrate hostile organizations. Sabotage military infrastructure, steal enemy funds, expose foreign plots and eliminate high-value targets.

Every operation requires a choice. Send your best agents on a dangerous mission and risk losing them, or wait while the enemy advances? Spend limited resources disrupting Volgravia, or use your intelligence network to convince foreign governments to send weapons and aid?

The war is fought on the front lines, but it can be won in the shadows.

BUILD YOUR INTELLIGENCE AGENCY

Recruit and manage up to 60 agents with different skills and backgrounds. Expand your organization, research new capabilities and decide where your limited resources are needed most.

RUN COVERT OPERATIONS

Choose from over 100 covert operations involving espionage, sabotage, cyber warfare, assassination, propaganda and political influence.

FIGHT A WAR FROM THE SHADOWS

Track the progress of the invasion and weaken the enemy without directly commanding conventional forces. Your operations influence how the war unfolds on the battlefield. Observe how the dynamic campaign unfolds in real time. 

MANIPULATE THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY

Influence foreign governments, secure military aid and shape world opinion. The right shipment of weapons could change the course of the war.

TRUST NO ONE

Enemy intelligence services are active. Hunt hostile spies, uncover double agents and protect your own organization from infiltration.

data.short_description: Lead your nation's intelligence agency through an invasion in the modern day. Recruit and manage spies, uncover double agents, run covert operations, and manipulate foreign powers to secure the support your country needs to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 530 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains stylized depictions of covert operations including assassination, sabotage, and political manipulation.

All violence is presented through text-based descriptions or strategic icons, with no graphic imagery.
Themes of espionage, war, and international conflict are present throughout.
